verdict.rationale: Skyvern publishes a per-endpoint API reference generated from its OpenAPI 3.1 spec, served at api.skyvern.com/openapi.json. The reference pages render a live "Try it" playground, so documented endpoints can be run in the browser. The root-domain OpenAPI probe 404s, but that only reflects where the spec is hosted and does not contradict the playground. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the playground runs across all endpoints, and evidence of runnable per-language code samples beyond the Run-an-agent page.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The "Run an agent" reference page renders a live "Try it" API playground (the Mintlify api.playground runtime) for its OpenAPI operation (post /v1/run/agents), so the documented endpoints are runnable in-browser.
Per-endpoint API reference generated from the OpenAPI specification
api.skyvern.com/openapi.json serves the machine-readable OpenAPI document
